app_metadata.tagline: Dream it. Plan it. Achieve it.
app_metadata.description: AspiraPath AI is your constraint-aware career and learning navigator. Whether you're returning from a career break, entering the workforce, or pivoting to a new field, this tool creates a personalized, achievable roadmap based on your real-world limitations and aspirations.

user_input_widgets.label: Career Aspiration
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., Transition into a Data Product Specialist / Junior Product Manager role in a hybrid or remote environment.

user_input_widgets.label: Current Situation
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., Returning professional with a 5-year career break due to maternity/caregiving. Past background as a Business Analyst.

user_input_widgets.label: Financial Constraints
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., Budget strictly under ₹3,000 for learning and certifications; prefers free open-source resources.

user_input_widgets.label: Time Constraints
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., 10-12 hours/week available (mostly 6:30-7:15 AM and 9:00-9:45 PM). Caregiving duties blocked 4:00-8:30 PM.

user_input_widgets.label: Geographic and Other Constraints
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., Mobile-first learning preferred during commute/breaks; low initial confidence in modern tech tools (SQL, Jira, AI workflows).

user_input_widgets.label: Life Change Scenario
user_input_widgets.placeholder: e.g., Missed 4 consecutive days in Week 5 due to child illness (6 hours lost). Need to recalculate schedule.
